# PLUGIN

Why use SDHubPvP?
SDHubPvP is a robust and fully configurable plugin that turns your hub into a dynamic and always-active PvP zone, allowing players to jump straight into combat without leaving the lobby, featuring fast respawn, kill and death tracking, safe-zone control, combat detection and a smooth, optimized experience even with many players online, ideal for servers looking for a modern, stable and customizable HubPvP setup.

# FEATURE #1

Advanced UX System
A fully customizable user experience module that delivers dynamic feedback through titles, actionbars, sounds, and messages. Designed to provide clear, responsive, and immersive gameplay interactions.

# FEATURE #2

Database Support
Seamless integration with SQLite and MariaDB, allowing flexible and efficient data storage for both small and large-scale environments.

# FEATURE #3

Fully Customizable
Every aspect of the plugin has been designed with flexibility in mind. From gameplay behavior to visual feedback and system settings, you have complete control to configure and adapt the plugin to perfectly match your server's needs and style.
